        let timeoutId;

          const context = this;

    <script>
(function () {
  const COOKIE_NAME = 'visiter_country';
  const COOKIE_DAYS = 7;
  function getCookie(name) {
    const match = document.cookie.match(
      new RegExp('(?:^|; )' + name + '=([^;]*)')
    );
    return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
  }
  function setCookie(name, value, days) {
    const expires = new Date();
    expires.setTime(expires.getTime() + days * 86400000);

    document.cookie =
      name + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value) +
      '; expires=' + expires.toUTCString() +
      '; path=/; SameSite=Lax; Secure';
  }
  function checkCountry(countryCode, countryName) {
    console.log('Visitor country:', countryCode);
    if (countryCode && countryCode !== 'IN') {
      document.body.innerHTML = `
        <div style="
          position:fixed;inset:0;background:#fff;
          display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
          flex-direction:column;z-index:9999999;text-align:center;
          font-family:Arial,sans-serif;padding:20px;">
          <h1>Coming Soon</h1>
          <p>Our store is currently available only in India.</p>
          <p>Country: ${countryName || countryCode}</p>
        </div>
      `;
    }
  }
  async function init() {
    const savedCountry = getCookie(COOKIE_NAME);
    if (savedCountry) {
      checkCountry(savedCountry, savedCountry);
      return;
    }
    try {
      const response = await fetch('https://ipwho.is/');
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Country lookup failed');
      const data = await response.json();
      if (data.success && data.country_code) {
        setCookie(COOKIE_NAME, data.country_code, COOKIE_DAYS);
        checkCountry(data.country_code, data.country);
        return;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('IP country lookup failed:', error);
    }

    const shopifyCountry = "IN";
    if (shopifyCountry) {
      setCookie(COOKIE_NAME, shopifyCountry, COOKIE_DAYS);
      checkCountry(shopifyCountry, shopifyCountry);
    }
  }
  init();
})();
</script>

  }:root {

      --font-size-xs: 0.64rem;
      --font-size-sm: 0.8rem;
      --font-size-base: 1rem;
      --font-size-lg: 1.25rem;
      --font-size-xl: 1.563rem;
      --font-size-2xl: 1.953rem;
      --font-size-3xl: 2.441rem;
      --font-size-4xl: 3.052rem;
      --font-size-5xl: 3.815rem;
      --font-size-6xl: 4.768rem;
      --font-size-7xl: 5.96rem;
      --font-size-8xl: 7.451rem;
      --font-size-9xl: 9.313rem;

      --type-scale-n-2: var(--font-size-xs);
      --type-scale-n-1: var(--font-size-sm);
      --type-scale-n0: var(--font-size-base);
      --type-scale-n1: var(--font-size-lg);
      --type-scale-n2: var(--font-size-xl);
      --type-scale-n3: var(--font-size-2xl);
      --type-scale-n4: var(--font-size-3xl);
      --type-scale-n5: var(--font-size-4xl);
      --type-scale-n6: var(--font-size-5xl);
      --type-scale-n7: var(--font-size-6xl);
      --type-scale-n8: var(--font-size-7xl);
      --type-scale-n9: var(--font-size-8xl);
      --type-scale-n10: var(--font-size-9xl);

      --base-font-size: 100.0%;
      --base-font-size-from-settings: 16;
      --base-line-height: 1.2;
      --heading-line-height: 1;

      font-size: var(--base-font-size);
      line-height: var(--base-line-height);

      --heading-font-stack: BebasNeue, Roboto;
      --heading-font-weight: 400;
      --heading-font-style: normal;


      --body-font-stack: Akzidenz-Grotesk Next, Roboto;
      --body-font-weight: 400;
      --body-font-bold: FontDrop;
      --body-font-bold-italic: FontDrop;

      --color-gridline: 0 0 0;
      --gridline-width: 1px;

      --text-border-width: 1px;
      --checkbox-width: 1px;

      --font-heading: Roboto, sans-serif;
      --font-body: Roboto, sans-serif;
      --font-body-weight: 400;
      --font-body-style: normal;
      --font-body-bold-weight: bold;

      --heading-letterspacing: 0.0;
      --heading-capitalize: none;
      --heading-decoration: none;

      --standard-heading-size: var(--type-scale-n2);
      --feature-heading-size: var(--type-scale-n3);
      --secondary-heading-size: var(--type-scale-n0);

      --body-copy-transform: none;

      --wrapperWidth: 100vw;
      --gutter: 1px;
      --rowHeight: calc((var(--wrapperWidth) - (11 * var(--gutter))) / 12);

      --global-scrolling-items-speed-multiplier: 1;

      --add-to-cart-button-height: 44px;
      --checkout-button-height: 44px;

      --spacing: 1rem;
      --spacing-double: 2rem;
      --spacing-half: 0.5rem;

      /* Equivalent to px-2 */
      --section-horizontal-spacing-mobile: 0.5rem;
      /* Equivalent to px-4 */
      --section-horizontal-spacing-desktop: 1rem;

      --section-horizontal-spacing: var(--section-horizontal-spacing-desktop);

      --icon-thickness: 1.5;

      /**
       * Buttons
       */
      --button-text-transform: none;
      --button-after-content: '\00a0\2192';
      --button-border-radius: 0;

      /**
       * Links
       */
      --links-bottom-border-width: var(--text-border-width);
      --links-bottom-padding: 0.25rem;
      --links-text-transform: none;
      --links-after-content: '\00a0\2192';
      --links-before-content: '\2190\00a0';

      background-color: rgb(var(--color-scheme-background));
      color: rgb(var(--color-scheme-text));
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      :root {
        --standard-heading-size: var(--type-scale-n6);
        --feature-heading-size: var(--type-scale-n7);
        --secondary-heading-size: var(--type-scale-n2);

        --section-horizontal-spacing: var(--section-horizontal-spacing-desktop);
      }
    }

    :root,
      
      [data-color-scheme="scheme1"] {
        --color-scheme-text: 7 0 1;
        --color-scheme-background: 255 255 255;
        --color-scheme-accent: 207 32 40;
        --color-scheme-accent-contrast:  255 255 255;
        --color-scheme-secondary: 66 66 66;
      }
  
      [data-color-scheme="scheme2"] {
        --color-scheme-text: 255 255 255;
        --color-scheme-background: 207 32 40;
        --color-scheme-accent: 255 255 255;
        --color-scheme-accent-contrast:  255 255 255;
        --color-scheme-secondary: 0 0 0;
      }
  
      [data-color-scheme="scheme3"] {
        --color-scheme-text: 207 32 40;
        --color-scheme-background: 255 255 255;
        --color-scheme-accent: 7 0 1;
        --color-scheme-accent-contrast:  255 255 255;
        --color-scheme-secondary: 207 32 40;
      }

<script>
    (function disableSchemasByType(schemaTypesToDisable = []) {
        if (!schemaTypesToDisable.length) return;
        const DEBUG = window.location.href?.includes("debug");
        const log = (...a) => DEBUG && console.log(...a);
        const removeAttrsDeep = (root, attrs) => {
            root.querySelectorAll("*").forEach((el) =>
                attrs.forEach((a) => el.removeAttribute(a))
            );
        };
        const extractTypesFromJsonLD = (json) => {
            const types = new Set();
            const walk = (v) => {
                if (!v) return;
                if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.forEach(walk);
                if (typeof v === "object") {
                    if (v["@type"]) {
                        (Array.isArray(v["@type"])
                            ? v["@type"]
                            : [v["@type"]]
                        ).forEach((t) => types.add(t));
                    }
                    if (v["@graph"]) walk(v["@graph"]);
                }
            };
            walk(json);
            return types;
        };
        const matchesSchemaType = (value) =>
            value && schemaTypesToDisable.some((t) => value.includes(t));
        const handleJsonLD = (container = document) => {
            container
                .querySelectorAll(
                    'script[type="application/ld+json"]:not([author="tpt"])'
                )
                .forEach((script) => {
                    try {
                        const raw = script.textContent.replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, " ");
                        const json = JSON.parse(raw);
                        const types = extractTypesFromJsonLD(json);
                        if (
                            [...types].some((t) => schemaTypesToDisable.includes(t))
                        ) {
                            script.type = "application/ldjson-disabled";
                            log("Disabled JSON-LD:", script);
                        }
                    } catch {}
                });
        };
        const handleMicrodata = (container = document) => {
            container
                .querySelectorAll(
                    schemaTypesToDisable
                        .map((t) => `[itemtype*="schema.org/${t}"]`)
                        .join(",")
                )
                .forEach((el) => {
                    el.removeAttribute("itemscope");
                    el.removeAttribute("itemtype");
                    el.removeAttribute("itemprop");
                    removeAttrsDeep(el, ["itemprop"]);
                });
        };
        const handleRDFa = (container = document) => {
            container
                .querySelectorAll(
                    schemaTypesToDisable
                        .map(
                            (t) =>
                                `[typeof*="${t}"],[vocab*="schema.org"][typeof*="${t}"]`
                        )
                        .join(",")
                )
                .forEach((el) => {
                    el.removeAttribute("vocab");
                    el.removeAttribute("typeof");
                    el.removeAttribute("property");
                    removeAttrsDeep(el, ["property"]);
                });
        };
        const processSchemas = (container) => {
            handleJsonLD(container);
            handleMicrodata(container);
            handleRDFa(container);
        };
        processSchemas();
        const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
            mutations.forEach((m) => {
                m.addedNodes.forEach((n) => {
                    if (n.nodeType !== 1) return;

                    if (
                        n.tagName === "SCRIPT" &&
                        n.type === "application/ld+json" &&
                        n.getAttribute("author") !== "tpt"
                    ) {
                        handleJsonLD(n.parentElement);
                        return;
                    }

                    const itemType = n.getAttribute?.("itemtype");
                    const typeOf = n.getAttribute?.("typeof");

                    if (matchesSchemaType(itemType) || matchesSchemaType(typeOf)) {
                        handleMicrodata(n.parentElement);
                        handleRDFa(n.parentElement);
                    } else {
                        processSchemas(n);
                    }
                });

                if (m.type === "attributes") {
                    const t = m.target;

                    if (
                        t.tagName === "SCRIPT" &&
                        t.type === "application/ld+json" &&
                        t.getAttribute("author") !== "tpt"
                    ) {
                        handleJsonLD(t.parentElement);
                    }

                    if (
                        m.attributeName === "itemtype" &&
                        matchesSchemaType(t.getAttribute("itemtype"))
                    ) {
                        handleMicrodata(t.parentElement);
                    }

                    if (
                        m.attributeName === "typeof" &&
                        matchesSchemaType(t.getAttribute("typeof"))
                    ) {
                        handleRDFa(t.parentElement);
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        observer.observe(document.body || document.documentElement, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true,
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ["itemtype", "typeof", "type"],
        });

        log("Schema disabler initialized with types:", schemaTypesToDisable);
    })(window.tptAddedSchemas);
</script>

<script class="tpt-seo-schema">
    var instantPageUrl = "https://cdn.shopify.com/extensions/01a18be3-db3e-7eff-abb8-cc67c4f225ad/tapita-seo-speed-249/assets/instantpage.js";
    var tptMetaDataConfigUrl = 'https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0925/5449/4247/t/170/assets/tapita-meta-data.json?v=1792731359';
    if (tptMetaDataConfigUrl) {
        fetch(tptMetaDataConfigUrl)
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then((data) => {
            if(!data) return;
            const instantPage = data?.instantPage || false;
            const excludedPaths = [
                '/cart',
                '/checkout',
                '/account',
                '/search',
                'logout',
                'login',
                'customer'
            ];
            if (!window.FPConfig || !window.FPConfig.ignoreKeywords || !Array.isArray(window.FPConfig.ignoreKeywords)) {
                window.FPConfig = { ignoreKeywords : excludedPaths };
            } else {
                window.FPConfig.ignoreKeywords = window.FPConfig.ignoreKeywords.concat(excludedPaths);
            }
            var toEnableInstantPageByPath = true;
            if (window.location.pathname && window.location.pathname.includes) {
                excludedPaths.forEach(excludedPath => {
                    if (window.location.pathname.includes(excludedPath)) {
                        toEnableInstantPageByPath = false;
                    }
                });
            }
            const spcBar = document ? document.getElementById('shopify-pc__banner') : null;
            if (spcBar)
                toEnableInstantPageByPath = false;
            if (window.document &&
                window.document.location &&
                window.document.location.pathname &&
                window.document.location.pathname.includes) {
                excludedPaths.forEach(excludedPath => {
                    if (window.document.location.pathname.includes(excludedPath)) {
                        toEnableInstantPageByPath = false;
                    }
                });
            }
            if(instantPage && toEnableInstantPageByPath){
                const tptAddInstantPage =  setInterval(function () {
                    try {
                        if(document && document.body && (window.top === window.self)){
                            var instantScript = document.createElement('script');
                            instantScript.src = instantPageUrl;
                            document.body.appendChild(instantScript);
                            clearInterval(tptAddInstantPage);
                        }
                    } catch (err) {
                        //
                    }
                }, 500);
            }
        });
    }
</script>

  <script>
  if (!customElements.get('sticky-header-height-helper')) {
    class StickyHeaderHeightHelper extends HTMLElement {
      constructor() {
        super();
      }

      connectedCallback() {
        const headerEl = this.closest('[data-theme-header]');

        const updateStickyHeaderHeight = () => {
          if (headerEl && headerEl.getAttribute('data-sticky')) {
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
              '--sticky-header-height',
              `${
                headerEl.closest('.shopify-section').getBoundingClientRect()
                  .height
              }px`
            );
          } else {
            

            document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
              '--sticky-header-height',
              '0px'
            );
          }
        };

        const debouncedUpdateStickyHeaderHeight = debounce(updateStickyHeaderHeight, 50);

        this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(debouncedUpdateStickyHeaderHeight);

        this.resizeObserver.observe(headerEl);
      }

      disconnectedCallback() {
        this.resizeObserver.disconnect();
        this.resizeObserver = null;
      }
    }

    customElements.define(
      'sticky-header-height-helper',
      StickyHeaderHeightHelper
    );
  }
  </script>

</div><script>
  const calculateHeaderHeights = () => {
    const headerGroupHeights = [];

    document
      .querySelectorAll('.shopify-section-group-header-group')
      .forEach((headerGroupSectionEl) => {
        headerGroupHeights.push(
          headerGroupSectionEl.getBoundingClientRect().height
        );
      });

    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      '--header-group-height',
      `${headerGroupHeights.reduce((subtotal, a) => subtotal + a, 0)}px`
    );
  };

  calculateHeaderHeights();

  const debouncedCalculateHeaderHeights = debounce(calculateHeaderHeights, 300);

  window.addEventListener('resize', debouncedCalculateHeaderHeights);
</script>

  #MainContent

  @media (min-width: 990px) {

    }

      > .shopify-section.banner-section:first-child

</style>
<script>
(function () {
  var timer = document.querySelector('.daily-timer');
  if (!timer) return;

  var mode = parseInt(timer.dataset.mode || '24', 10);
  var resetTime = timer.dataset.resetTime || '13:00';

  var timeParts = resetTime.split(':');
  var startHour = parseInt(timeParts[0], 10);
  var startMinute = parseInt(timeParts[1], 10);

  var cycle = mode * 60 * 60 * 1000;

  function getTargetTime() {
    var now = new Date();

    /*
     * First cycle starts at the configured time.
     */
    var start = new Date();
    start.setHours(startHour, startMinute, 0, 0);

    /*
     * If the current time is before today's start,
     * use yesterday's start.
     */
    if (now < start) {
      start.setDate(start.getDate() - 1);
    }

    var elapsed = now.getTime() - start.getTime();

    /*
     * Find the next 12/24 hour cycle.
     */
    var cyclesPassed = Math.floor(elapsed / cycle);

    return new Date(
      start.getTime() + (cyclesPassed + 1) * cycle
    );
  }

  function updateTimer() {
    var now = new Date();
    var target = getTargetTime();

    var diff = target.getTime() - now.getTime();

    if (diff < 0) diff = 0;

    var totalSeconds = Math.floor(diff / 1000);

    var hours = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
    var minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
    var seconds = totalSeconds % 60;

    timer.querySelector('.daily-timer__hours').textContent =
      String(hours).padStart(2, '0') + ' H';

    timer.querySelector('.daily-timer__minutes').textContent =
      String(minutes).padStart(2, '0') + ' M';

    timer.querySelector('.daily-timer__seconds').textContent =
      String(seconds).padStart(2, '0') + ' S';
  }

  updateTimer();
  setInterval(updateTimer, 1000);
})();
</script>

    <div id="shopify-block-AQlZpNXBnMmFNTlVaR__reels_app_x_tech_it_video_collection_LBLL3t" class="shopify-block shopify-app-block">

<!-- BEGIN app snippet: reels_block_core --><!-- BEGIN app snippet: reels_analytics_client --><script>
  (function () {
    if (window.ReelsAnalytics) return;

    const ACTOR_KEY = "reels_actor_id";
    const ACTOR_STATE_KEY = "reels_actor_state_v1";
    const SESSION_KEY = "reels_session_id";
    const SESSION_LAST_SEEN_KEY = "reels_session_last_seen_at";
    const SESSION_CONTEXT_KEY = "reels_session_context_v1";
    const ACTOR_TTL_MS = 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    const SESSION_TTL_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;
    const ANALYTICS_URL = "/apps/reels/analytics";
    const CART_URL = "/cart.js";
    const CART_ADD_PATH_REGEX = /\/cart\/add(?:\.js)?(?:\?|$)/i;

    let cartTokenCache = null;
    let cartTokenLoadedAt = 0;

    const readJson = (key, fallback) => {
      try {
        const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
        return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : fallback;
      } catch {
        return fallback;
      }
    };

    const writeJson = (key, value) => {
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
      } catch {}
    };

    const setString = (key, value) => {
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(key, value);
      } catch {}
    };

    const getString = (key) => {
      try {
        return window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    };

    const nowMs = () => Date.now();
    const nowIso = () => new Date().toISOString();
    const toIso = (value) => new Date(value).toISOString();
    const generateId = () =>
      window.crypto && typeof window.crypto.randomUUID === "function"
        ? window.crypto.randomUUID()
        : `reels-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}-${nowMs()}`;

    const normalizeIdValue = (value) => {
      if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
      const normalized = String(value).trim();
      return normalized.length > 0 ? normalized : null;
    };

    const extractNumericId = (value) => {
      const normalized = normalizeIdValue(value);
      if (!normalized) return null;
      if (/^[0-9]+$/.test(normalized)) return normalized;
      const parts = normalized.split("/");
      const tail = parts[parts.length - 1];
      return /^[0-9]+$/.test(tail) ? tail : null;
    };

    const getActorId = () => {
      const actorState = readJson(ACTOR_STATE_KEY, null);
      if (
        actorState &&
        normalizeIdValue(actorState.id) &&
        Number.isFinite(actorState.expires_at) &&
        actorState.expires_at > nowMs()
      ) {
        setString(ACTOR_KEY, actorState.id);
        return actorState.id;
      }

      const actorId = generateId();
      const nextState = {
        id: actorId,
        expires_at: nowMs() + ACTOR_TTL_MS,
      };
      writeJson(ACTOR_STATE_KEY, nextState);
      setString(ACTOR_KEY, actorId);
      return actorId;
    };

    const createEmptyContext = () => ({
      updated_at: nowIso(),
      videos: {},
    });

    const getSessionContext = () => {
      const context = readJson(SESSION_CONTEXT_KEY, null);
      if (!context || typeof context !== "object" || typeof context.videos !== "object") {
        return createEmptyContext();
      }
      return context;
    };

    const persistSessionContext = (context) => {
      context.updated_at = nowIso();
      writeJson(SESSION_CONTEXT_KEY, context);
    };

    const ensureSession = () => {
      const lastSeenRaw = getString(SESSION_LAST_SEEN_KEY);
      const lastSeen = Number.parseInt(lastSeenRaw || "", 10);
      const sessionId = getString(SESSION_KEY);
      const expired =
        !Number.isFinite(lastSeen) || !sessionId || nowMs() - lastSeen > SESSION_TTL_MS;

      if (expired) {
        const nextSessionId = generateId();
        setString(SESSION_KEY, nextSessionId);
        setString(SESSION_LAST_SEEN_KEY, String(nowMs()));
        const freshContext = createEmptyContext();
        persistSessionContext(freshContext);
        return {
          actorId: getActorId(),
          sessionId: nextSessionId,
          context: freshContext,
        };
      }

      setString(SESSION_LAST_SEEN_KEY, String(nowMs()));
      return {
        actorId: getActorId(),
        sessionId,
        context: getSessionContext(),
      };
    };

    const inferPageType = () => {
      const pathname = window.location.pathname || "/";
      if (pathname === "/") return "home";
      if (pathname.startsWith("/products/")) return "product";
      if (pathname.startsWith("/collections/")) return "collection";
      if (pathname.startsWith("/cart")) return "cart";
      return "other";
    };

    const getCurrentProductHandle = () => {
      const pathname = window.location.pathname || "";
      if (!pathname.startsWith("/products/")) return null;
      const segments = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
      return segments.length >= 2 ? decodeURIComponent(segments[1]) : null;
    };

    const getVideoContext = (videoId) => {
      if (!videoId) return null;
      const state = ensureSession();
      return state.context.videos[videoId] || null;
    };

    const upsertVideoContext = (item, options = {}) => {
      const state = ensureSession();
      const context = state.context;
      const videoId = normalizeIdValue(item?.video_id);
      if (!videoId) {
        return {
          actorId: state.actorId,
          sessionId: state.sessionId,
          entry: null,
        };
      }

      const existing = context.videos[videoId] || {
        product_id: null,
        variant_id: null,
        variant_numeric_id: null,
        product_handle: null,
        view_count: 0,
        pdp_click_count: 0,
        in_video_atc_count: 0,
        last_viewed_at: null,
        last_pdp_click_at: null,
        last_in_video_atc_at: null,
        unique_view_tracked: false,
      };

      if (options.incrementView) {
        existing.view_count += 1;
        existing.last_viewed_at = nowIso();
      }
      if (options.markPdpClick) {
        existing.pdp_click_count += 1;
        existing.last_pdp_click_at = nowIso();
      }
      if (options.markInVideoAtc) {
        existing.in_video_atc_count += 1;
        existing.last_in_video_atc_at = nowIso();
      }

      existing.product_id = normalizeIdValue(item?.product_id) || existing.product_id;
      existing.variant_id = normalizeIdValue(item?.variant_id) || existing.variant_id;
      existing.variant_numeric_id =
        extractNumericId(item?.variant_id) || existing.variant_numeric_id;
      existing.product_handle =
        normalizeIdValue(item?.product_handle) || existing.product_handle;

      context.videos[videoId] = existing;
      persistSessionContext(context);

      return {
        actorId: state.actorId,
        sessionId: state.sessionId,
        entry: existing,
      };
    };

    const getCartToken = async () => {
      if (cartTokenCache && nowMs() - cartTokenLoadedAt < 5 * 60 * 1000) {
        return cartTokenCache;
      }

      try {
        const response = await window.fetch(CART_URL, {
          method: "GET",
          credentials: "same-origin",
          headers: {
            Accept: "application/json",
          },
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
          return null;
        }

        const payload = await response.json();
        cartTokenCache = normalizeIdValue(payload?.token);
        cartTokenLoadedAt = nowMs();
        return cartTokenCache;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    };

    const sendEvent = async (payload, options = {}) => {
      const eventPayload = {
        event_type: payload.event_type,
        event_id: payload.event_id || generateId(),
        actor_id: payload.actor_id,
        session_id: payload.session_id,
        video_id: payload.video_id || null,
        product_id: payload.product_id || null,
        variant_id: payload.variant_id || null,
        page_type: payload.page_type || inferPageType(),
        page_url: payload.page_url || window.location.href,
        referrer: payload.referrer || document.referrer || null,
        occurred_at: payload.occurred_at || nowIso(),
        metadata: payload.metadata || {},
      };

      const cartToken = await getCartToken();
      if (cartToken) {
        eventPayload.metadata.cart_token = cartToken;
      }

      return window.fetch(ANALYTICS_URL, {
        method: "POST",
        credentials: "same-origin",
        headers: {
          "content-type": "application/json",
          Accept: "application/json",
        },
        keepalive: Boolean(options.keepalive),
        body: JSON.stringify(eventPayload),
      }).catch(() => null);
    };

    const buildLineItemProperties = ({
      actorId,
      sessionId,
      videoId,
      productId,
      variantId,
      attributionType,
      eventId,
    }) => ({
      _reels_actor_id: actorId,
      _reels_session_id: sessionId,
      _reels_video_id: videoId,
      _reels_product_id: productId,
      _reels_variant_id: variantId || "",
      _reels_attribution_type: attributionType,
      _reels_event_id: eventId,
    });

    const hasReelsProperties = (properties) =>
      Boolean(properties && normalizeIdValue(properties._reels_video_id));

    const CAROUSEL_VIEW_KEY = "reels_carousel_view_tracked";
    const ATC_TRACKED_KEY = "reels_atc_tracked";

    const getAtcTrackedKey = (sessionId, videoId) => {
      const normalizedSessionId = normalizeIdValue(sessionId);
      const normalizedVideoId = normalizeIdValue(videoId);
      if (!normalizedSessionId || !normalizedVideoId) return null;
      return `${ATC_TRACKED_KEY}_${normalizedSessionId}_${normalizedVideoId}`;
    };

    const hasAddToCartBeenTracked = ({ sessionId, videoId }) => {
      const storageKey = getAtcTrackedKey(sessionId, videoId);
      return storageKey ? Boolean(getString(storageKey)) : false;
    };

    const markAddToCartTracked = ({ sessionId, videoId }) => {
      const storageKey = getAtcTrackedKey(sessionId, videoId);
      if (storageKey) setString(storageKey, "1");
    };

    const isAddToCartEvent = (eventPayload) =>
      eventPayload?.event_type === "cta_add_to_cart" ||
      eventPayload?.event_type === "pdp_add_to_cart";

    const registerCarouselView = () => {
      const state = ensureSession();
      const storageKey = `${CAROUSEL_VIEW_KEY}_${state.sessionId}`;
      if (getString(storageKey)) return Promise.resolve();
      setString(storageKey, "1");

      return sendEvent({
        event_type: "carousel_view",
        actor_id: state.actorId,
        session_id: state.sessionId,
        video_id: null,
        product_id: null,
        variant_id: null,
        metadata: {},
      });
    };

    const trackVideoOpen = (item) => {
      const state = upsertVideoContext(item, { incrementView: true });
      if (!state.entry) return Promise.resolve();

      return sendEvent({
        event_type: "video_open",
        actor_id: state.actorId,
        session_id: state.sessionId,
        video_id: item.video_id,
        product_id: item.product_id,
        variant_id: item.variant_id || null,
        metadata: {
          view_count: state.entry.view_count,
          product_handle: item.product_handle || null,
        },
      });
    };

    const trackVideoScroll = (item) => {
      const state = upsertVideoContext(item);
      if (!state.entry) return Promise.resolve();

      return sendEvent({
        event_type: "video_scroll",
        actor_id: state.actorId,
        session_id: state.sessionId,
        video_id: item.video_id,
        product_id: item.product_id,
        variant_id: item.variant_id || null,
        metadata: {
          view_count: state.entry.view_count,
          product_handle: item.product_handle || null,
        },
      });
    };

    const trackVideoClose = (item, extraMetadata = {}) => {
      const state = upsertVideoContext(item);
      if (!state.entry) return Promise.resolve();

      return sendEvent(
        {
          event_type: "video_close",
          actor_id: state.actorId,
          session_id: state.sessionId,
          video_id: item.video_id,
          product_id: item.product_id,
          variant_id: item.variant_id || null,
          metadata: {
            view_count: state.entry.view_count,
            product_handle: item.product_handle || null,
            ...extraMetadata,
          },
        },
        { keepalive: true }
      );
    };

    const trackProductClick = (item) => {
      const state = upsertVideoContext(item, { markPdpClick: true });
      if (!state.entry) return Promise.resolve();

      return sendEvent(
        {
          event_type: "cta_product_click",
          actor_id: state.actorId,
          session_id: state.sessionId,
          video_id: item.video_id,
          product_id: item.product_id,
          variant_id: item.variant_id || null,
          metadata: {
            view_count: state.entry.view_count,
            product_handle: item.product_handle || null,
          },
        },
        { keepalive: true }
      );
    };

    const prepareDirectAddToCart = (item) => {
      const initialState = ensureSession();
      const videoId = normalizeIdValue(item?.video_id);
      const alreadyTracked = hasAddToCartBeenTracked({
        sessionId: initialState.sessionId,
        videoId,
      });
      const state = upsertVideoContext(item, {
        markInVideoAtc: Boolean(videoId && !alreadyTracked),
      });
      const eventId = generateId();
      const eventPayload = alreadyTracked
        ? null
        : {
            event_type: "cta_add_to_cart",
            event_id: eventId,
            actor_id: state.actorId,
            session_id: state.sessionId,
            video_id: item.video_id,
            product_id: item.product_id,
            variant_id: item.variant_id || null,
            metadata: {
              view_count: state.entry ? state.entry.view_count : 0,
              product_handle: item.product_handle || null,
              attribution_type: "direct",
            },
          };

      return {
        eventPayload,
        properties: buildLineItemProperties({
          actorId: state.actorId,
          sessionId: state.sessionId,
          videoId: item.video_id,
          productId: item.product_id,
          variantId: item.variant_id || null,
          attributionType: "direct",
          eventId: eventPayload ? eventId : "",
        }),
      };
    };

    const trackPreparedEvent = (eventPayload, options) => {
      if (!eventPayload) return Promise.resolve(null);
      if (isAddToCartEvent(eventPayload)) {
        if (
          hasAddToCartBeenTracked({
            sessionId: eventPayload.session_id,
            videoId: eventPayload.video_id,
          })
        ) {
          return Promise.resolve(null);
        }
        markAddToCartTracked({
          sessionId: eventPayload.session_id,
          videoId: eventPayload.video_id,
        });
      }
      return sendEvent(eventPayload, options);
    };

    const getAllVideoContexts = () => {
      const state = ensureSession();
      return Object.entries(state.context.videos).map(([videoId, entry]) => ({
        videoId,
        ...entry,
      }));
    };

    const resolveWinningContext = ({ variantNumericId } = {}) => {
      const currentHandle = getCurrentProductHandle();
      const candidates = getAllVideoContexts()
        .map((entry) => {
          const sameProduct =
            (currentHandle && entry.product_handle === currentHandle) ||
            (variantNumericId &&
              entry.variant_numeric_id &&
              entry.variant_numeric_id === variantNumericId);

          let score = 0;
          let occurredAt = entry.last_viewed_at || entry.last_pdp_click_at || entry.last_in_video_atc_at;
          if (sameProduct && entry.last_pdp_click_at) {
            score = 400;
            occurredAt = entry.last_pdp_click_at;
          } else if (sameProduct && entry.last_viewed_at) {
            score = 300;
            occurredAt = entry.last_viewed_at;
          } else if (!sameProduct && entry.last_viewed_at) {
            score = 100;
            occurredAt = entry.last_viewed_at;
          }

          if (!score) {
            return null;
          }

          return {
            score,
            occurredAt,
            sameProduct,
            entry,
          };
        })
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((left, right) => {
          if (right.score !== left.score) {
            return right.score - left.score;
          }
          return new Date(right.occurredAt).getTime() - new Date(left.occurredAt).getTime();
        });

      if (!candidates.length) {
        return null;
      }

      const { entry, sameProduct } = candidates[0];
      return {
        attributionType: sameProduct ? "assisted_same_product" : "assisted_other_product",
        videoId: entry.videoId,
        productId: entry.product_id,
        variantId: entry.variant_id,
        productHandle: entry.product_handle,
        viewCount: entry.view_count,
      };
    };

    const decorateItemPayload = (item) => {
      const itemCopy = { ...item };
      itemCopy.id = normalizeIdValue(itemCopy.id);

      const existingProperties =
        itemCopy.properties && typeof itemCopy.properties === "object"
          ? { ...itemCopy.properties }
          : {};
      if (hasReelsProperties(existingProperties)) {
        return { item: itemCopy, eventPayload: null };
      }

      const winningContext = resolveWinningContext({
        variantNumericId: extractNumericId(itemCopy.id),
      });
      if (!winningContext) {
        return { item: itemCopy, eventPayload: null };
      }

      const state = ensureSession();
      const alreadyTracked = hasAddToCartBeenTracked({
        sessionId: state.sessionId,
        videoId: winningContext.videoId,
      });
      const eventId = generateId();
      itemCopy.properties = {
        ...existingProperties,
        ...buildLineItemProperties({
          actorId: state.actorId,
          sessionId: state.sessionId,
          videoId: winningContext.videoId,
          productId: winningContext.productId,
          variantId: winningContext.variantId,
          attributionType: winningContext.attributionType,
          eventId: alreadyTracked ? "" : eventId,
        }),
      };

      return {
        item: itemCopy,
        eventPayload: alreadyTracked
          ? null
          : {
              event_type: "pdp_add_to_cart",
              event_id: eventId,
              actor_id: state.actorId,
              session_id: state.sessionId,
              video_id: winningContext.videoId,
              product_id: winningContext.productId,
              variant_id: winningContext.variantId || null,
              metadata: {
                attribution_type: winningContext.attributionType,
                view_count: winningContext.viewCount || 0,
                product_handle: winningContext.productHandle || null,
              },
            },
      };
    };

    const decorateJsonPayload = (payload) => {
      if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object") {
        return { payload, eventPayload: null };
      }

      if (Array.isArray(payload.items)) {
        let winnerEvent = null;
        payload.items = payload.items.map((item) => {
          const decorated = decorateItemPayload(item);
          if (!winnerEvent && decorated.eventPayload) {
            winnerEvent = decorated.eventPayload;
          }
          return decorated.item;
        });
        return { payload, eventPayload: winnerEvent };
      }

      const decorated = decorateItemPayload(payload);
      return {
        payload: decorated.item,
        eventPayload: decorated.eventPayload,
      };
    };

    const formDataToPayload = (formData) => {
      const properties = {};
      formData.forEach((value, key) => {
        const match = key.match(/^properties\[(.+)\]$/);
        if (match) {
          properties[match[1]] = value;
        }
      });

      return {
        id: formData.get("id"),
        quantity: formData.get("quantity") || "1",
        properties,
      };
    };

    const applyPropertiesToForm = (form, properties) => {
      Object.entries(properties).forEach(([key, value]) => {
        const selector = `input[name="properties[${key}]"]`;
        let input = form.querySelector(selector);
        if (!input) {
          input = document.createElement("input");
          input.type = "hidden";
          input.name = `properties[${key}]`;
          form.appendChild(input);
        }
        input.value = value;
      });
    };

    const mergeDecoratedPayloadIntoFormData = (formData, decoratedPayload) => {
      const nextFormData = new FormData();
      let hasId = false;
      let hasQuantity = false;

      formData.forEach((value, key) => {
        if (key.match(/^properties\[(.+)\]$/)) {
          return;
        }

        if (key === "id") {
          hasId = true;
          nextFormData.append(key, decoratedPayload.id ?? value);
          return;
        }

        if (key === "quantity") {
          hasQuantity = true;
          nextFormData.append(key, decoratedPayload.quantity ?? value);
          return;
        }

        nextFormData.append(key, value);
      });

      if (!hasId && decoratedPayload.id !== undefined && decoratedPayload.id !== null) {
        nextFormData.append("id", decoratedPayload.id);
      }

      if (
        !hasQuantity &&
        decoratedPayload.quantity !== undefined &&
        decoratedPayload.quantity !== null
      ) {
        nextFormData.append("quantity", decoratedPayload.quantity);
      }

      if (decoratedPayload.properties && typeof decoratedPayload.properties === "object") {
        Object.entries(decoratedPayload.properties).forEach(([propertyKey, propertyValue]) => {
          nextFormData.append(`properties[${propertyKey}]`, propertyValue);
        });
      }

      return nextFormData;
    };

    const interceptFetch = () => {
      if (window.__reelsFetchIntercepted) return;
      window.__reelsFetchIntercepted = true;

      const originalFetch = window.fetch.bind(window);
      window.fetch = async (input, init = {}) => {
        const requestUrl =
          typeof input === "string"
            ? input
            : input instanceof URL
              ? input.toString()
              : input && typeof input.url === "string"
                ? input.url
                : "";
        const requestMethod = String(
          init.method || (input && input.method) || "GET"
        ).toUpperCase();

        if (
          !requestUrl ||
          !CART_ADD_PATH_REGEX.test(requestUrl) ||
          requestMethod !== "POST" ||
          input instanceof Request
        ) {
          return originalFetch(input, init);
        }

        let eventPayload = null;
        const nextInit = { ...init };

        if (typeof init.body === "string") {
          try {
            const payload = JSON.parse(init.body);
            const decorated = decorateJsonPayload(payload);
            nextInit.body = JSON.stringify(decorated.payload);
            eventPayload = decorated.eventPayload;
          } catch {}
        } else if (init.body instanceof FormData) {
          const payload = formDataToPayload(init.body);
          const decorated = decorateJsonPayload(payload);
          nextInit.body = mergeDecoratedPayloadIntoFormData(init.body, decorated.payload);
          eventPayload = decorated.eventPayload;
        }

        const response = await originalFetch(input, nextInit);
        if (response.ok && eventPayload) {
          trackPreparedEvent(eventPayload).catch(() => null);
        }
        return response;
      };
    };

    const interceptForms = () => {
      if (window.__reelsFormIntercepted) return;
      window.__reelsFormIntercepted = true;

      document.addEventListener(
        "submit",
        (event) => {
          const form = event.target;
          if (!(form instanceof HTMLFormElement)) return;
          const action = form.getAttribute("action") || "";
          const method = String(form.getAttribute("method") || "GET").toUpperCase();
          if (!CART_ADD_PATH_REGEX.test(action) || method !== "POST") return;

          const payload = formDataToPayload(new FormData(form));
          const decorated = decorateJsonPayload(payload);
          if (!decorated.eventPayload || !decorated.payload.properties) return;

          applyPropertiesToForm(form, decorated.payload.properties);
          trackPreparedEvent(decorated.eventPayload, { keepalive: true }).catch(
            () => null
          );
        },
        true
      );
    };

    interceptFetch();
    interceptForms();

    window.ReelsAnalytics = {
      ensureSession,
      extractNumericId,
      getVideoContext,
      prepareDirectAddToCart,
      registerCarouselView,
      resolveWinningContext,
      trackPreparedEvent,
      trackVideoClose,
      trackProductClick,
      trackVideoOpen,
      trackVideoScroll,
      upsertVideoContext,
    };
  })();
</script>

    var slideshowEl = document.querySelector(".responsive-slideshow");
    if (!slideshowEl || typeof Swiper === 'undefined') {

    var autoplayEnabled = slideshowEl.dataset.autorotate;
    var autoplaySpeed = parseInt(slideshowEl.dataset.autorotateSpeed, 10);

    // Swiper configuration
    var swiperConfig = {
      slidesPerView: 1,
      spaceBetween: 0,
      loop: true,
      pagination: {
        el: ".swiper-pagination",
        clickable: true
      }
    };

    // Add autoplay configuration conditionally
    if (autoplayEnabled === "true") {
      swiperConfig.autoplay = {
        delay: autoplaySpeed,
        disableOnInteraction: false
      };
    }

    // Initialize Swiper
    var swiper = new Swiper(".responsive-slideshow", swiperConfig);
  });
</script>
